title: Experimental Study of Carbon Dioxide Solubility in Sodium Chloride and Calcium Chloride Brines at 333.15 and 453.15 K for Pressures up to 40 MPa
experimental_method: New stirred variable-volume reactor; liquid sample trapped in NaOH solution and CO2 determined by titration with HCl (two equivalence points).
uncertainties_stated: ur(gas solubility)=0.028, ur(salt molality)=0.001, u(T)=0.50 K, u(P)=0.06 MPa
quality_remarks: Abstract says 20 original data, Table 7 has 20 rows; Table 6 (12 validation rows) not counted there. Abstract: pure water validation at 333.15 K, single-salt validation at 323.15 K, matches Table 6. Pressure absolute/gauge not stated. Salt molality is per kg H2O. Captured tables are inline plus popup duplicates (11 captures = 7 printed tables; Tables 1-4 captured twice, inline and popup). One printed misspelling in Table 4 text ('NaCl0.2 mol CaCl2') irrelevant. Brine at 453.15 K only for mixed salt; single-salt brines only at 333.15 K although abstract wording says both temperatures.
extraction_notes: System-name cell printed beside first data row written as its own label row (rule 10). Footnote d (no literature data) in Table 6 row 25.06 MPa emptied and recorded in note column. Header footnote letters stripped. Values verbatim.
mapping_audit: independent mapping audit 2026-10-02 (audit.json); cell-for-cell match with the captured HTML rows
